LogEntry.description:
One divergence entry as the task log carries it and a landing keeps
it (S-0057/D-7): the row it cites, what reality said, the evidence, what
the executor did. `class` is the log's key; the field is `entry_class`
because the word is Python's.

action.description: What the executor did: halted, departed or decided.
action.title: Action

at.description: The instant the entry was written (S-0058/D-7).
at.title: At

class.description: `class` in the log: discovery, spec-gap, drift or irreducible.
class.title: Class

decision.description: The row the entry cites, `S-NNNN/D-n`; local inside the row's own document.
decision.title: Decision

evidence.description: A `path:line` citation or a backticked command with its output (S-0005/D-4).
evidence.title: Evidence

grade.description: The row's grade as the executor read it, or UNLISTED when no document lists it.
grade.title: Grade

kind.description: What happened: contradicted, departed, resolved or blocked.
kind.title: Kind

notes.description: Anything else the reader of the log should know.
notes.title: Notes

proposal.description: The row the executor proposes for the author to append.
proposal.title: Proposal

LogEntry.title: LogEntry

description:
The task log's own shape, `.torve/tasks/T-NNNN/log.yaml` (S-0001
§6): the pin, the derived drift count and the entries — what `torve
init` writes the log's schema from (S-0057/D-5).

base.description: The commit the work started from — the pin's other half (S-0001/D-36).
base.title: Base

drift_count.description: The entries classed drift, declared so the gate can compare its own count.
drift_count.title: Drift Count

entries.description: The divergence entries, in the order they were written.
entries.title: Entries

repo.description: The repository the evidence resolves against, `owner/name` — the pin (S-0001/D-36).
repo.title: Repo

schema_version.description: The log's shape version: 2 says `base` (S-0059/D-8); 1 said `base_sha`.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

task.description: The task the log belongs to, `T-NNNN`.
task.title: Task

title: TaskLog
